descriptionHtml:
As the second phase of “The Career Blueprint”, the Mock Interview Session provided final-year undergraduates of the Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering with a realistic simulation of corporate recruitment processes. This in-person session aimed to bridge the gap between academic preparation and industry expectations, helping students experience the dynamics of professional interviews in a structured environment.

The session featured a distinguished panel of industry experts, including:

  • Eng. M.R. Ranatunga – Former General Manager, Ceylon Electricity Board (CEB)

  • Eng. Mahesh Thilakasiri – Senior Vice President – Projects, Lakdhanavi Limited

  • Eng. Noorul Munawwara – Deputy General Manager, Ceylon Electricity Board (CEB)

  • Eng. Pulatsthi Perera – Senior Electrical Engineer, Vega Innovations

  • Eng. Gihantha Wijesekara – Senior Engineer – Electronics, Vega Innovations

Each participant underwent a panel-style interview, followed by personalized feedback from these seasoned professionals, enabling them to understand their strengths and areas for improvement. This unique experience not only enhanced students’ interview skills and confidence but also gave them industry-aligned insights into employer expectations.

By integrating real-world expertise into an academic setting, Session 02 effectively prepared graduates for smooth transitions into their professional careers, reflecting IEEE’s mission of fostering career readiness and lifelong learning.
venue: New Mechanical Building, Seminar Room, Faculty of Engineering
